title: Policy Improvement-Guided Replay for Continual Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.25989v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Continual reinforcement learning (CRL) requires models to acquire new capabilities while retaining performance on previous tasks. A stability-oriented perspective common in conventional continual learning emphasizes knowledge preservation and interference mitigation. Complementing this perspective, we revisit CRL for vision-language models through policy improvement, a fundamental principle of RL, to preserve acquired performance gains. Using the performance difference lemma, we characterize historical performance changes through the current policy's expected advantages on historical task distributions, motivating replay of historical prompts with the current policy. To allocate limited replay memory, we propose Contrastive Likelihood Replay (CoLiR), which contrasts likelihood gains on correct responses from the final task policy with likelihood reductions on incorrect responses from the initial policy. translated_title: 策略改进引导的持续强化学习重放方法
translated_abstract: 持续强化学习（CRL）要求模型在获得新能力的同时保持之前任务上的性能。传统持续学习中常见的面向稳定性的视角强调知识保留和干扰缓解。作为对这一视角的补充，我们通过策略改进——强化学习的一个基本原则——重新审视视觉语言模型的持续强化学习，以保留已获得的性能提升。利用性能差分引理，我们通过当前策略在历史任务分布上的期望优势来刻画历史性能变化，从而启发使用当前策略对历史提示进行重放。为了分配有限的重放记忆，我们提出了对比似然重放（CoLiR），该方法将最终任务策略对正确回答的似然增益与初始策略对错误回答的似然降低进行对比。我们的分析将正确回答与……
tldr: 该论文提出对比似然重放方法（CoLiR），基于策略改进原则和性能差分引理，在视觉语言模型的持续强化学习中选择性重放历史提示，从而在获得新能力的同时保留已取得的性能提升。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Contrastive Likelihood Replay (CoLiR), which leverages the policy improvement principle and the performance difference lemma to selectively replay historical prompts in continual reinforcement learning for vision-language models, preserving acquired performance gains while acquiring new capabilities.
